Name: Natural Medium Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere!
[/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]Someone asked for it and here it is!
Custom medium-sized natural farm, add this farm to your game. Since nothing changes in your saves feel free to try it out
[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4]
On this farm you will catch some unusual fish and fishing here is a good earner, it has a working minecart, a [/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=3]boat has a one-way trip to the beach[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4], it has forest forage and when you are out of energy you can take a relaxing bath in the creek.

[/size][/color][size=3][size=3]Additional information about the farm:[/size][/size][size=3][size=3]
-On this farm you can fish:[/size][/size][color=#00ffff][size=3][size=3]sturgeon, catfish, goby, woodskip, largemouth bass, bullhead, river jelly, green algae,[/size][/size][/color][size=3][size=3]regardless of seasons or rain[/size][/size], this is to make fishing more profitable and also because I love those fish.[size=3]
[/size][size=3]-[/size][color=#00ffff][size=3]The boat has a one-way trip to the boat on the beach near Elliot's house, here's why: [/size][/color][size=3]the boat on the beach near Elliot's house is just a decorative element, if you hover the mouse over it it doesn't do anything, on this farm insteadI put the boat, both as a decorative element, but also as a one-way trip to the beach, I gave it a utility, because unlike the minecart which has a network throughout Stardew Valley, the boat does not have it.

Enjoy! <3
